name: EncQA
description: A benchmark for assessing vision-language models' ability to interpret and answer questions about visual encodings in charts and plots.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for chart and plot understanding used to evaluate multimodal models' ability to reason about visual encodings; adoption is growing in VQA and chart-understanding research.
notes: Focused on questions about visual encodings in charts; susceptible to annotation ambiguity and distributional shifts; primarily a non-LLM multimodal benchmark.
